definitions.explanation: An enclosure or shelter for keeping birds. Can range from a small outdoor birdhouse to a chicken coop to a larger aviary at a zoo or park.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{鳥小屋|とりごや}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I built a birdhouse in the garden.

examples.japanese: {鳥小屋|とりごや}の{掃除|そうじ}を{毎日|まいにち}する。
examples.english: I clean the birdcage every day.

examples.japanese: {動物園|どうぶつえん}の{鳥小屋|とりごや}には{色|いろ}とりどりの{鳥|とり}がいた。
examples.english: The aviary at the zoo had birds of many colors.

notes:
Composed of {鳥|とり} (bird) + {小屋|こや} (shed, hut, small building). The word covers various sizes of bird enclosures. In rural settings, it often refers specifically to a {鶏小屋|にわとりごや} (chicken coop). The {小屋|こや} component undergoes rendaku, becoming ごや.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥小屋|とりごや}を{作|つく}る: to build a birdhouse
- {鳥小屋|とりごや}の{掃除|そうじ}: cleaning the birdcage/coop
- {鳥小屋|とりごや}で{飼|か}う: to keep in a birdcage

RELATED WORDS:
- {鶏小屋|にわとりごや}: chicken coop (specifically for chickens)
- {犬小屋|いぬごや}: doghouse
- {小屋|こや}: hut, shed (base word)
- {巣箱|すばこ}: nesting box, birdhouse (specifically for nesting)
